_about: Metadata for one character sheet. All coordinates are pixels in the sheet image, measured from its top-left corner. Copy this file for each new character and update the numbers.

three_quarter._box: left, top, right, bottom of the whole figure, head to feet

front_arm._half_width: half the stroke width plus anti-aliasing, in pixels

expressions._about: Box around each expression head. Keep labels out of the box; stray bits are dropped automatically.
